0.original: Hihibaru has a suggestion to help you with your investigation.

1.original: In light of your run-in with an Ala Mhigan bandit, Hihibaru recommends that you next take your investigation to Little Ala Mhigo. His daughter, a lass named Hihira, has taken up residence there, and should be able to lend you a hand.

2.original: Hihira has no knowledge of Lahabrea. She recommends you speak with a man named Gundobald, the leader of the refugee settlement.

3.original: As forewarned, you receive a cold welcome from Gundobald. It seems that some effort will be required on your part if the residents of Little Ala Mhigo are to warm to you.

24.original: Speak with Hihira at Little Ala Mhigo.

48.original: The Ala Mhigan bandit you had a run-in with is somehow connected to your masked man of mystery.

49.original: So, it stands to reason that if you want to pick up the trail again, you should head toward Little Ala Mhigo, over in southern Thanalan.

50.original: Just so you know what to expect, the settlement is the favored destination for those refugees who couldn't...well, <hex:021A020203>adapt<hex:021A020103> to life in Ul'dah.

51.original: The hearts of the denizens are said to be as barren as the wasteland they live in. And for all intents and purposes, it's a lawless place. Be prepared for a not-so-warm welcome.

52.original: Now, I'm not certain how much a help she will be, but it just so happens I have a daughter who has, er...<hex:021A020203>relocated<hex:021A020103> to Little Ala Mhigo. Her name is Hihira, and it shouldn't hurt to seek her out first.

53.original: And while you have her attention...I'd be obliged if you could send my love. Not a day goes by that I don't think of her.

54.original: I suppose this is it, then! I had hoped that you would linger here a while─cull some fiends, spend some coin, what have you─but something tells me you're destined for greater things. Wherever it is you end up, I wish you the best!

55.original: ...Hm? Why, yes, Hihibaru's my father... He said <hex:021A020203>what<hex:021A020103>?<hex:02100103><sigh> I wish I could be a better daughter to him. It's just that─ Oh, I'm sorry... I shouldn't bother you with family matters. But I am grateful to you for delivering the message. Now then, what brings you here?

56.original: A masked man? I'm afraid the description doesn't ring any bells, but one of the others here may have seen something. I would recommend you first speak with Gundobald, the leader of the settlement. I must warn you, though, he isn't exactly...accommodating to outsiders.

57.original: Who are you? State your business, and be quick about it.

58.original: Looking for a masked villain, you say? And why should we help you, pray?

59.original: We struggle enough without having to answer the whim of every outsider.

60.original: You are not welcome here. Begone.
